INDIGOTAILOR-ADJACENT.description: [aqua]Adjacent[/aqua] refers to hand cards directly next to each other.
INDIGOTAILOR-ADJACENT.title: Adjacent
INDIGOTAILOR-CUT.description: Exhaust a target card in hand to spawn corresponding 0-cost [aqua]Embryo[/aqua] tokens (Attacks yield [gold]Needle Embryo[/gold], Skills yield [gold]Cloth Embryo[/gold], others yield [gold]Thread Embryo[/gold]). Cards with split components split into Left and Right halves at each end of the hand.
INDIGOTAILOR-CUT.title: Cut
INDIGOTAILOR-LOOM_SEAM.description: [aqua]Selvedge[/aqua] refers to the leftmost (first) or rightmost (last) card in hand.
INDIGOTAILOR-LOOM_SEAM.title: Selvedge
INDIGOTAILOR-MATERIAL_STITCH_DEFAULT: Gain a [aqua]Patch[/aqua] based on the sub-card type.
INDIGOTAILOR-MATERIAL_STITCH_PRICE: Add a [aqua]Wound[/aqua] into your hand when the host card is played.
INDIGOTAILOR-MATERIAL_STITCH_SCAB: Heal 1 HP when the host card is played.
INDIGOTAILOR-MATERIAL_STITCH_TANGLED: Draw 1 card when the host card is played.
INDIGOTAILOR-MATERIAL_STITCH_WOUND: Heal 1 HP when the host card is played.
INDIGOTAILOR-SELVEDGE.description: [aqua]Selvedge[/aqua] refers to the leftmost (first) or rightmost (last) card in hand.
INDIGOTAILOR-SELVEDGE.title: Selvedge
INDIGOTAILOR-STITCH.description: Exhaust 1 [aqua]Adjacent[/aqua] secondary card to attach it as a [aqua]Patch[/aqua] onto the host card. Cards without a dedicated stitch effect grant base embryo bonuses and add 1 [gold]Tangled Hemp[/gold] to hand. Standard stitching allows up to 3 [aqua]Patches[/aqua] per host card.
INDIGOTAILOR-STITCH.title: Stitch
INDIGOTAILOR-UNPICK.description: Strip all [aqua]Patches[/aqua] from a target card in hand, adding 1 corresponding upgraded [aqua]Embryo+[/aqua] to hand for each patch removed.
INDIGOTAILOR-UNPICK.title: Unpick
INDIGOTAILOR-UNRAVEL.description: Reduces enemy Block gained by 5% per stack (max 50%). When attacked, takes +2 extra damage and loses 1 stack of [aqua]Unravel[/aqua].
INDIGOTAILOR-UNRAVEL.title: Unravel
